prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: Ishmael, the bandaged man helping the hospital escape in MGSV The Phantom Pain. Adult athletic male patient, head and face fully wrapped in off-white layered gauze with narrow openings for eyes, nose and mouth; NO eyepatch or military headgear. Dull teal-green short-sleeved loose knee-length hospital gown, fabric continuous and modestly closed from side view, exposed lower legs, gray-blue hospital slippers. Wrist/forearm gauze wraps. Faithful to the actual game model shown alongside Konami/Shinkawa Ishmael concept. Row1 four alert upright idle breathing phases. Row2 four compact cautious right-facing hospital-escape walking stages with distinct foot placement heel, compress, pass, opposite heel. Row3 four restrained beckoning/pointing gestures to guide another patient, arm raise and lower; no other person. Row4 four lowering into crouch then regaining guarded stance. All heads and noses point RIGHT. Both feet and full bandaged head inside every cell. No gun needed, no blood, no exposed buttocks or nudity, no detached marks.
IMPORTANT: Ishmael has BARE LOWER LEGS with visible normal human skin from the bottom of the gown to his BLUE-GRAY SLIPPERS. Absolutely no gauze on thighs, knees, calves or ankles. Only his HEAD and WRISTS have bandages. He is NOT a mummy. Do not wrap all limbs. The four walk frames use alternating front and rear leg positions with a passing pose legs close together, not four similar strides. Keep all other requirements.

references.kind: secondary mirror of attributed Konami/Shinkawa concept and game model

notes: Teal hospital gown, head/wrist wraps and blue-gray slippers retained.
Extra lower-leg bandages from v1 rejected; v2 has bare lower legs.
16 authored four-action archive poses; exact1:1 likeness and perfect motion continuity are not claimed.
